uutiset.t: HDBank Turns to Global Investors With Bonds, Loan to Fund Growth in Vietnam
uutiset.s: Ho Chi Minh City Development JSC Bank is planning to both sell global bonds and borrow via the syndicated loan market, turning to overseas investors to meet rising credit demand in an economy chasing ambitious growth goals.

uutiset.t: Gold Holds Decline as US Tariff Plans Reinforce Rate-Hike Bets
uutiset.s: Gold held a decline, after the White House’s latest tariff plans drove equities lower and reinforced expectations for an interest-rate hike by the Federal Reserve.

uutiset.t: RBA’s Jacobs Says Financial Conditions ‘Restrictive’ After Hikes
uutiset.s: Australia’s financial conditions are “clearly restrictive” following five interest-rate increases this year, a senior Reserve Bank official said, while also noting the difficulty of determining the extent.

uutiset.t: US Readies Tariff Hike on China, EU Goods
uutiset.s: The US is set to announce plans to raise tariffs on goods from China, the European Union and more than a dozen other economies, according to people familiar with the matter. Bloomberg’s Derek Wallbank has the latest. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Butterball CEO on Thanksgiving Dinner Outlook
uutiset.s: Jay Jandrain, Butterball CEO, says U.S. turkey production is slightly higher than last year and holiday turkey prices are broadly consistent with prior years. uutiset.t: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Nov. 25
uutiset.s: Oil slipped as traders weighed signs of rising supply against escalating attacks on vessels around the Strait of Hormuz.

uutiset.t: Icahn’s Fortune Sinks to $1.3b as Debt Pressures Rise
uutiset.s: Carl Icahn’s fortune has dwindled to about $1.3 billion as mounting debt squeezes his business empire, leaving the longtime corporate raider and activist investor facing one of the toughest stretches of his career. uutiset.t: US Steel Buyers Turn Abroad as Data Center Boom Strains Supply
uutiset.s: Cheaper Asian imports are gaining traction with US steel buyers despite Washington’s tariffs, as a data center construction boom squeezes domestic supplies and drives up prices.

uutiset.t: Asian Stocks Fall as AI Trade Doubts Resurface: Markets Wrap
uutiset.s: Asian stocks retreated, tracking losses on Wall Street, after a renewed selloff in US technology stocks revived doubts about the durability of the artificial intelligence trade.

uutiset.t: BOJ Likely to Lift Rate to 2% by Mid-2027, Ex-Board Member Says
uutiset.s: The Bank of Japan will likely raise its benchmark interest rate three more times to 2% through the middle of next year, taking it to a level not seen since 1993, according to a former BOJ board member.

uutiset.t: US Readies Tariff Hike on China, EU Goods
uutiset.s: The US is set to announce as soon as Tuesday plans to raise tariffs on goods from China, the European Union and more than a dozen other economies, according to people familiar with the matter. Alicia Diaz reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Quant Funds Are Having a Hard Time Keeping Up With This Market
uutiset.s: The stock market narrative is shifting so quickly even so-called fast money can’t keep up.

uutiset.t: Bond Traders Rush to Hedge Risk of Fed Hikes Stalling Economy
uutiset.s: Bond traders are racing to hedge the risk that the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate hikes and the stock market’s slide will significantly slow the US economy, forcing the central bank to shift back to easing monetary policy as soon as late next year.

uutiset.t: Advent Weighs Takeover Of Testing Firm Bureau Veritas
uutiset.s: Advent is considering a bid to acquire French testing firm Bureau Veritas SA, people with knowledge of the matter said, in what would be one of the largest buyouts of a European company this year.

uutiset.t: Canadian Dollar Gains Most Since August on Inflation Warning
uutiset.s: The Canadian dollar logged its biggest gain in more than three months after the head of the Bank of Canada warned higher oil costs will further drive up consumer prices, compounding persistent inflation.
